about: Cartoon: a short story with simple, colourful cartoon characters drawn in code. Example: 'The Long Game', one buyer from an anonymous visit to a booked meeting weeks later, carried by Breakout's agent. Times in bars at 120 BPM (1 bar = 2 s). Captions are verbatim page headlines from getbreakout.ai/use-cases (saved 2026-10-09); people and companies are fictional.
